question: A batsman can be given out in_________ ways.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• A batsman can be given out in10 ways.

**The 10 ways are:**

 
• Player can be Bowled out.
 
• LBW ( leg before wicket).
 
• Player can get caught out.
 
• Hit wick
